reader.requirement: At --std 85 after a body group the RWCS sets LINE-COUNTER as follows: a control footing below the highest break level keeps its final print line under a, b, c and f. Otherwise: absolute NEXT GROUP gives the integer if the final line is below it, else FOOTING with the integer saved (a); relative gives final line + integer if below FOOTING, else FOOTING (b); NEXT PAGE gives FOOTING (c); no NEXT GROUP gives the final line (d); a nonprintable body group leaves LINE-COUNTER unchanged (e); unpaged relative gives final line + integer (f).

reader.notes: ApplyNextGroup's body arm implements 6a (LC < integer ? integer : FOOTING + save), 6b (sum < FOOTING ? sum : FOOTING), 6c (FOOTING), 6f (unpaged sum). 6d is the final PresentLine value, and 6e holds because BeginGroup returns false for a dummy group before any line. The lower-level-footing exception is PresentBody's applyNextGroup = (level == break level) from ProcessControlFootings, at a break and at TERMINATE (break level 0). 2023 output is identical except for the saved-integer-at-TERMINATE arm, where 85 follows its own text.

refuter.evidence: Read ApplyNextGroup's body arm (6a: LC < integer ? integer : FOOTING with the integer saved; 6b: sum < FOOTING ? sum : FOOTING; 6c: FOOTING; 6f: unpaged sum) and ProcessControlFootings (applyNextGroup only for i == breakLevel; TERMINATE passes 0, the most major control, which is FINAL or the first named control). Probe q2_cf_levels.cob (runs/q2_cf_levels-001, --std 85; CONTROLS ARE K1 K2 with no FINAL, CF-K2 NEXT GROUP 12, CF-K1 NEXT GROUP PLUS 3): break at K2: CF2 line 4 -> next DE 'BEFORE DE LC 12' (6a, highest level K2); break at K1: CF2 line 14 kept 'BEFORE CF1 LC 14' (lower-level footing, NEXT GROUP ignored), CF1 line 15 + 3 -> 'BEFORE DE LC 18' (6b); TERMINATE without FINAL: CF2 at 20 kept ('BEFORE CF1 LC 20'), CF1 at 21 + 3 -> 'AFTER TERMINATE LC 24'. All as the text gives. The q1_saved_plus0 defect recorded under 1985-GR-XIII.3.10.8-4 changes WHERE a group lands, not the LINE-COUNTER setting this rule gives after it (6d was the final line there too). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR6  (3.10.8 Body Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR6'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR3  (3.16.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3'.
